title: Proposal(k) Render Payload
description: Contract for POST /render. This is the payload Design(k) Pro (or any upstream (k) Suite module) sends to Proposal(k) to generate a partner-branded plan services proposal PDF.

vendor.description: Partner adapter key. Upstream Census(k) sets this based on file signature detection. Defaults to 'cetera' if omitted.

proposal_meta.description: Metadata about the proposal itself — dates, plan year.

sponsor.description: The plan sponsor — the business adopting the plan.

scenario.description: The plan design outcome from Design(k) Pro.

plan_type.description: Cetera-style label: 'Custom(k) Plan', 'Easy(k) Plan', '401(k) PSP with Cash Balance'.

owner_share_pct.description: ADVISORY ONLY. The Worker's template recomputes this from the totals using Cetera's convention (Owner Total / (Owner Total + Non-Owner Total), deferral included). If upstream sends a different value, it will be overridden at render time.

column_headers.description: Per-scenario column labels for the participant detail table.

er_1.description: e.g., '3% Safe Harbor' or 'Safe Harbor Match'

er_2.description: e.g., 'Profit Sharing' or 'CB' for cash balance

irs_limits.description: IRS limits for the plan year. Template uses these to build the 402(g) footnote dynamically; values should come from Design(k)'s IRS limits block.

fees.description: Partner fee schedule. Comes from the partner adapter defaults, editable in the Proposal(k) review screen.

billing_frequency.description: How each line item is billed.

participants.description: Participant roster with allocations. Must contain at least one row with is_owner=true.

plan_comp.description: Comp used for plan calc — already clipped to §401(a)(17) upstream

is_spouse_attribution.description: §318(a)(1) family attribution — set true for spouse/child/grandchild/parent of a direct owner. Sourced from Census(k)'s _isAttributedOwner + _familyRel='SPOUSE'.

footnote_marks.description: Footnote reference marks to render next to the participant's name (e.g., ['*', '†'] for the owner's compliance notes).

er_1.description: First ER contribution column (SHNE 3%, SH Match, etc.)

er_2.description: Second ER contribution column (Profit Sharing, CB credit, etc.)

compliance_notes.description: Per-participant footnotes that render under the detail table (keyed to footnote_marks in order: first note → '*', second → '†', third → '‡').
